title: Uniform Coupling under Gibbs Uniqueness
statement: For a specification on $\mathbb Z^d$ with a unique Gibbs state, is it true that for every $\varepsilon>0$ there is an $N$ such that, for all $n\geq N$, every pair of boundary conditions outside the $n$-box induces inside-box measures that can be coupled with expected number of disagreements at most $\varepsilon$?
